payment.feesAndTaxesDescription: How service fees and taxes apply to each order
payment.checkoutRailsNotice: Guest card and checkout methods (like Mercado Pago) are set up under Plugins. This page is for fees, taxes, and optional crypto wallets only.
payment.settlementAddressDescription: Optional wallet where crypto sales settle. Not required for Mercado Pago or card checkout.
payment.walletOwnerOnly: Only the business owner can change payout wallets.
payment.addressInvalid: Enter a valid wallet address (0x followed by 40 hex characters).
payment.tipWalletMustDiffer: Tip wallet must be different from the sales settlement wallet so tips can be paid out separately.
payment.confirmAddressChangeDescription: You are changing a payout wallet. Funds sent to the old address won't reach the new one. Current: {old} — New: {new}. Continue?
payment.confirmAddressChangeTipNotice: Tips go to the tip wallet; sales go to the settlement wallet — keep them different.
payment.tippingAddressDescription: Separate wallet for tips so staff tip pools stay apart from sales revenue.
payment.payoutNotice: Only needed if you accept crypto. Keep the tip wallet different from the sales wallet.
payment.walletConnectionUnavailableDescription: No injected wallet found and WalletConnect is not configured.
payment.walletNotConnectedDescription: Connect your wallet first, then try again.
payment.addressesUpdatedDescription: Settlement and tipping addresses were updated from your wallet.
payment.addressUpdatedDescription: Address was updated from your wallet.
payment.taxRateDescription: Local tax rate as a percent
payment.serviceFeeInclusiveDescription: Include service fee in displayed prices
payment.sampleCheckDescription: Live preview for a {{amount}} subtotal using the rates above — what a new bill would charge after you save.
payment.sampleCheckInclusiveNote: Inclusive toggles change how menu prices are labeled. Bill math still applies tax and service fee to the subtotal, as shown above.
payment.effectiveDateDescription: These rates apply to new bills as soon as you save. Scheduling a future rate change is not available yet.
payment.effectiveDateOpenBillsNote: Open bills already on the floor keep their current totals; only new checks use the saved rates.

notifications.emailDescription: Control which emails you receive from Payverge
notifications.ordersAndPaymentsDesc: Receive emails when orders are placed or payments are received
notifications.reportsAndAnalyticsDesc: Periodic business reports and performance summaries
notifications.operationalDescription: Repeating staff alerts for orders, kitchen tickets, reservations, delivery, bills, and payments.
notifications.operationalEnabledDesc: Create staff-visible alerts for active workflows.
notifications.operationalSoundEnabledDesc: Play sounds until a repeating alert is claimed or resolved. Off by default — turn on only when you want audible alarms.
notifications.operationalSoundOptInHint: Opt-in: leaving this off keeps the dinner floor quiet while alerts still appear on screen.
notifications.operationalBrowserEnabledDesc: Show browser notifications when new alerts arrive. Requires permission in this browser.
notifications.operationalRepeatIntervalFloorHint: 30 seconds minimum so repeats cannot fire every 8s during dinner service.
notifications.operationalEventsDescription: Choose which workflows create alerts and which ones repeat until staff addresses them.
notifications.chatSoundsDescription: These only affect this browser/device — they aren't synced to your account.
notifications.chatAnnouncementSoundDesc: Play a sound when a manager posts a business-wide announcement.
notifications.chatMessageSoundDesc: Play a sound for regular channel and DM messages. Off by default to stay quiet during service.

operationalTypes.table_stale_occupied: Occupied table with no recent activity

operationalTypeDescriptions.order_new: Alerts bills staff when a customer or staff member creates an order.
operationalTypeDescriptions.kitchen_order_ready: Alerts kitchen staff when an approved order is ready for preparation.
operationalTypeDescriptions.reservation_new: Alerts hosts when a booking is confirmed or a waitlist request is created.
operationalTypeDescriptions.reservation_approval: Alerts hosts when a guest reservation request is waiting for manual approval. Repeats until handled.
operationalTypeDescriptions.delivery_new: Alerts dispatch staff when a delivery order is created.
operationalTypeDescriptions.bill_new: Alerts staff when a new bill is opened.
operationalTypeDescriptions.payment_requested: Alerts staff when a guest asks to pay with an alternative method.
operationalTypeDescriptions.payment_received: Alerts staff when a payment is received or confirmed.
operationalTypeDescriptions.payment_refund_review: Alerts staff when a partial provider refund needs manual reconciliation.
operationalTypeDescriptions.service_call: Alerts floor staff when a guest taps Call waiter at their table. Repeats until acknowledged.
operationalTypeDescriptions.ai_takeover: Alerts staff when a guest writes in a paused AI chat that nobody has claimed. Repeats until someone takes over.

notifications.telegramDescription: Events that trigger a Telegram message to your connected chat
notifications.telegramNotConnected: Connect Telegram in the Plugins tab to configure notifications
notifications.telegramComingSoon: Per-event Telegram preferences coming soon — all events are currently sent.
notifications.pushDescription: Receive alerts even when the dashboard is closed
notifications.directorDigestDesc: Receive a daily email digest with AI-generated business insights
notifications.scopeLegendDescription: Email follows your login, operational alerts and Telegram follow this business, chat sounds stay on this device, and desktop alerts also need permission in this browser. Each section is labeled so nothing is saved in the wrong place.
notifications.saveModelHint: These toggles save immediately. Profile, payments, and languages still use Save changes.
